project.description: Applies pending database migration scripts at server boot, all in a single transaction, gating the application readiness (/health) until done. The migration scripts are bundled in the application jar and contributed via the MigrationScriptsProvider SPI; the statements are executed through the generic SubmitService API, so this module stays platform-neutral. On failure, everything is rolled back and the application never becomes ready, which makes a blue/green deployment roll back to the previous version while the database is left untouched.
